qualifier: including negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation
name: Myoblast proliferation and migration with differentiation restraint
rationale: All members concern myoblast commitment, migration, proliferation, fusion or differentiation control; unlike the myogenesis and pro-differentiation/satellite-cell confusables, the theme carries negative regulation of myoblast and myotube differentiation and proliferation.

qualifier: cohesion, alignment and checkpoint control
name: Meiotic chromosome cohesion, alignment and segregation checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover meiotic sister-chromatid cohesion, chiasmata, metaphase alignment, segregation and the metaphase/anaphase checkpoint, distinct from confusables centred on recombination/synapsis or female meiosis I spindle positioning.

qualifier: integrin activation, Rap1 and Rho-ROCK/PAK to cell spreading
name: Integrin activation and Rap1/Rho signalling for cell spreading
rationale: Members describe integrin activation and adhesion-complex signalling via Rap1, Rho-ROCK/PAK, p130Cas and GRB2:SOS that drive stress fibres and spreading, unlike confusables about platelet/BTM cytoskeleton, fibronectin matrix, shear stress or migration.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
qualifier: TLR2/4, LPS, TNF and NF-kappaB signalling inhibition
name: Suppression of TLR2/4–NF-kappaB inflammatory cytokine signalling
rationale: Every member is negative regulation of TLR2/4/LPS, TNF or NF-kappaB signalling or of IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF production, whereas confusables add positive cytokine regulation, inflammasome or IL-10/IL-12 control and lack the NF-kappaB/TNF inhibition.

qualifier: with T-cell response regulation (Th1, IL-2/IL-21, Treg)
name: TLR–NF-kappaB cytokine inhibition and T-cell response regulation
rationale: Members are mostly negative regulation of TLR/LPS, NF-kappaB and inflammatory cytokine production plus IL-37 and IL-10, with T-cell items (Th1, IL-2, IL-21, Treg, activated T cell proliferation) that the innate-only confusables lack and NF-kappaB inhibition that the T-cell suppression confusable lacks.

qualifier: ribosomal subunit and Rev cargo export
name: Nuclear pore transport of ribosomal subunits and Rev cargo
rationale: All members concern the nuclear pore complex and traffic through it, and the theme is set apart from NPC assembly/disassembly and inositol-phosphate transport confusables by ribosomal subunit export and HIV Rev import/export.

qualifier: sarcomere filament assembly
name: Striated muscle sarcomere filament assembly and contraction
rationale: Members cover thin/thick filament and myofibril assembly, actin-myosin sliding and striated contraction, which none of the confusables (muscle growth/atrophy, cardiac junctions, adaptation) contain.

qualifier: kainate/AMPA receptors and G-protein-gated channels
name: Kainate/AMPA receptor and G-protein-gated channel synaptic signalling
rationale: Members are ionotropic kainate/AMPA receptor activation and G-protein beta-gamma control of K+ and Ca2+ channels shaping presynaptic potential, distinct from confusables on excitatory plasticity, presynaptic calcium/inhibitory synapses or nicotinic receptors.

qualifier: tubulin glutamylation and microtubule severing
name: Centrosomal microtubule organization with tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members address microtubule nucleation, anchoring and stability at the centrosome, and the theme differs from spindle/centriole/cilium confusables by tubulin C-terminal polyglutamylation/deglutamylation and severing.

qualifier: with error-free translesion bypass
name: UV lesion nucleotide-excision repair and error-free bypass
rationale: Members cover GG- and TC-NER of UV pyrimidine dimers and error-free POLH translesion synthesis, whereas confusables centre on error-prone translesion polymerases, replication and base-excision repair.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and collagen/laminin basement membrane
name: Desmosome, hemidesmosome and collagen–laminin basement membrane adhesion
rationale: Members are cell-cell (desmosome, cadherin) and cell-basement membrane (hemidesmosome, integrin, laminin, collagen, anchoring fibril) adhesion, distinguished from adherens-junction/polarity/EMT confusables by the hemidesmosome and basement-membrane matrix members.

qualifier: HIF, NRF2 and p53
name: HIF, NRF2 and p53 regulation of glycolytic metabolism
rationale: Members combine hypoxia/HIF signalling, NFE2L2 target programmes and p53/mTORC1 metabolic regulation with glycolysis, fructose bisphosphate and pentose-phosphate control, unlike FOXO-centred or ROS/ferroptosis confusables.

qualifier: leucine, valine and isoleucine with inborn organic acidurias
name: Leucine, valine and isoleucine catabolism and organic acidurias
rationale: Members are leucine, valine and isoleucine catabolic steps and their enzyme deficiencies plus short-chain acyl catabolism, lacking the biotin, threonine/carnitine or 2-hydroxyglutarate content of the confusables.

qualifier: RUNX1-regulated erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic lineages
name: RUNX1-regulated erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic hematopoiesis
rationale: Members span HSC maintenance and erythroid, megakaryocyte, granulocyte and other myeloid differentiation with many RUNX1 transcriptional programmes, which confusables centred on M-CSF/macrophage signalling or bone marrow development lack.

qualifier: visual cycle in rods and cones and its inherited defects
name: Visual-cycle retinoid metabolism and its inherited defects
rationale: Members are retinol/retinal metabolism, the rod and cone retinoid cycles and diseases from LRAT, RDH5/12, ABCA4 and STRA6 loss, distinct from retinoic acid confusables and opsin phototransduction confusables.

qualifier: inherited organic acidurias
name: Leucine catabolism and inherited organic acidurias
rationale: All members are leucine catabolism or its organic aciduria enzyme defects (isovaleric, MCC, 3-methylglutaconic, ketothiolase), with none of the valine, fatty acid oxidation, biotin or carnitine content of confusables.

qualifier: factor VIII and factor IX
name: Defective coagulation factor VIII and IX variants
rationale: Every member is a defective factor VIII or factor IX variant of the tenase complex, whereas confusables cover the normal cascade, fibrinolysis, VWF and contact-pathway defects.

qualifier: sperm tail axoneme, manchette and mitochondrial sheath
name: Spermatogenic assembly of sperm tail structures
rationale: Members concern building sperm-specific structures during spermatogenesis (manchette, axoneme central apparatus, mitochondrial sheath, Sertoli barrier), distinct from confusables on motile cilia dynein arms, sperm motility regulation or tubulin modification.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and quality control
qualifier: dynamics and PINK1–Parkin mitophagy
name: Mitochondrial protein import, dynamics and PINK1–Parkin quality control
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial protein import/processing/degradation, cristae, fission-fusion, membrane potential and PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, separating the theme from general autophagy/pexophagy confusables and from the ER-tethering dynamics confusable.

core: Cardiac contractility and heart rate regulation
qualifier: via sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling
name: Sarcoplasmic calcium regulation of cardiac contractility and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium uptake/release and plasma-membrane calcium flux to set cardiac force, relaxation and rate, unlike confusables on skeletal ryanodine/store-operated calcium, gap-junction conduction or action potentials.

qualifier: nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: Members follow intermediate mesoderm to nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching, whereas confusables centre on metanephric mesenchyme and nephron segment development.

name: Hox gene cluster expression
rationale: All six members are Hox cluster gene-expression sets, with no neural plate, somitogenesis or RUNX1 programmes found in the confusables.

qualifier: break sensing, NHEJ/HR choice and ADP-ribosylation
name: Double-strand break sensing, repair-pathway choice and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM recruitment, classical and alternative NHEJ, regulation of NHEJ versus HR and protein (de-)ADP-ribosylation, distinct from BRCA-driven HR confusables and replication-stress/chromatin confusables.

qualifier: proliferation and plasma-cell differentiation
name: B cell proliferation and plasma-cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell activation, proliferation, germinal-centre/B-1 differentiation, Tfh/ICOS help and plasma-cell immunoglobulin signatures, the plasma-cell content separating it from memory/homeostasis B cell confusables.

qualifier: SLC39/SLC30 transport and MTF1–metallothionein
name: Zinc transport and MTF1–metallothionein heavy-metal response
rationale: Members are zinc uptake/efflux and homeostasis plus MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc, cadmium, copper and mercury, distinct from copper/manganese transport confusables and other-metal response confusables.
